image_description: A low-angle shot of a blue and white airship (dirigible) against a clear blue sky. The envelope is predominantly dark blue with a large white rectangular panel on the side featuring red text that appears to read 'EUWANE' or similar gibberish. A gondola is suspended beneath the forward section, and small fins are visible at the tail. The lighting suggests a bright sunny day.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The red text on the white panel reads 'EUWANE' or similar nonsensical characters. While this is a common AI artifact, it mimics real-world stylized branding enough that it doesn't immediately break immersion, but it is clearly not valid English or standard typography.

The gondola lacks fine mechanical detail. It appears somewhat 'melted' or simplified compared to the crispness of the hull. The connection points between the gondola and the hull are slightly indistinct.
The geometry of the tail fins seems slightly inconsistent with the curvature of the hull, appearing somewhat flat or pasted on rather than integrated into the 3D structure.
